SELECT SUBSTRING(r.r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20), AVG(ws.ws_quantity), AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr.wr_fee)
FROM (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS ws_item_sk,
           ws.ws_order_number AS ws_order_number,
           ws.ws_quantity AS ws_quantity,
           ws.ws_sales_price AS ws_sales_price,
           ws.ws_net_profit AS ws_net_profit
    FROM web_sales AS ws
    JOIN date_dim AS dd ON dd.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    JOIN web_page AS wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year = 1998
      AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 200.00
      AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
) AS ws
JOIN (
    SELECT wr.wr_item_sk AS wr_item_sk,
           wr.wr_order_number AS wr_order_number,
           wr.wr_refunded_cash AS wr_refunded_cash,
           wr.wr_fee AS wr_fee,
           wr.wr_reason_sk AS wr_reason_sk,
           cd1.cd_marital_status AS cd1_marital_status,
           cd1.cd_education_status AS cd1_education_status,
           cd2.cd_marital_status AS cd2_marital_status,
           cd2.cd_education_status AS cd2_education_status,
           ca.ca_country AS ca_country,
           ca.ca_state AS ca_state
    FROM web_returns AS wr
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd1 ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd2 ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
    JOIN customer_address AS ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
    WHERE cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
      AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
      AND cd1.cd_marital_status IN ('D', 'S', 'U')
      AND cd1.cd_education_status IN ('Primary', 'College', 'Advanced Degree')
      AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
      AND ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA', 'WI', 'WV', 'GA', 'OK', 'VA', 'KY')
) AS wr ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
JOIN reason AS r ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
WHERE cd1_marital_status = cd2_marital_status
  AND cd1_education_status = cd2_education_status
  AND ((cd1_marital_status = 'D' AND cd1_marital_status = cd2_marital_status AND cd1_education_status = 'Primary' AND cd1_education_status = cd2_education_status AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00) OR (cd1_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1_marital_status = cd2_marital_status AND cd1_education_status = 'College' AND cd1_education_status = cd2_education_status AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00) OR (cd1_marital_status = 'U' AND cd1_marital_status = cd2_marital_status AND cd1_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND cd1_education_status = cd2_education_status AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00))
  AND ((ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200) OR (ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300) OR (ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250))
GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY SUBSTRING(r.r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20), AVG(ws.ws_quantity), AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr.wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
